evidence_quotes.name_handling: Rep asked for name at top ('I'm looking to speak with DC'), customer provided Roselyn Pammit, but rep never used customer name again in the call after that point.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: No framing of time investment, dependability promise, or explicit agreement before probing. Rep jumped directly into 'just to make sure we have the correct details' as a kickoff call retroactively.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep went straight into logistics checklist without surfacing customer concerns.
evidence_quotes.two_promises: On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage were never mentioned.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: Rep did not ask 'What items in this move are you most concerned about?' Instead went directly to address confirmation and logistics.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Box count asked: 'typical back count based on your home size is 75 to 95 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range?' Packing asked: 'Do you need help in packing?'
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: Rep correctly identified 1800 sq ft home size qualifies for virtual walkthrough: 'normally based on your home size, we do a virtual walkthrough.' Confirmed customer could do it today, created FaceTime link, and routed cleanly to walkthrough with proper handoff.

top_strength: Rep correctly identified the move size threshold for virtual walkthrough routing and executed a clean handoff with link creation and confirmation.
coaching_note: This is a kickoff call, not an initial sales call, but it still skipped Two Promises and any discovery of customer concerns—neither should be deferred even on callbacks.
